# Predicting the timing offset from the SCG alone (generated by scripts/delay_features.py)

shift_ms: the shift of the U-Net output that best matches the real ECG, measured on a calibration clip (positive = output late). Mean absolute error in ms of three ways to guess it without any ECG.

|               |   people |   MAE no shift |   MAE training mean |   MAE SCG features (LOO) |   Spearman(pred, actual) |
|:--------------|---------:|---------------:|--------------------:|-------------------------:|-------------------------:|
| CEBS          |       16 |           7.67 |                 8   |                    13.41 |                    -0.28 |
| SensSmartTech |       32 |          35.02 |                26.3 |                    21.17 |                     0.44 |

|:--------------|------:|----------------:|----------------:|---------------:|--------------:|
